name: anc4_mp2
purpose: TASKS 291: the MP2 basis step of the composite anchors — DF-MP2 Hessian rows at cc-pVDZ and cc-pVTZ (psi4 1.11, check W passed on the server at deploy: 4.9e-9 / 4.9e-8 Eh/bohr against 1e-6) for this server's molecules, the CC wave's first, then the DFT batch's that are done without an imaginary mode; list made at deploy by probes/deploy_dfmp2_lane.sh. One lane of 4 threads under an 8 GB cap; it waits for the server's DFT lane to end and then takes its core share.
command: WAIT_PGREP='[l]abels_batch_ccx53.sh /root/dft1' bash probes/dfmp2_lane.sh /root/mp2b MP /root/dft1/anc4_dft1.log '=== \(AD\) all done'

estimate.basis: not measured on these servers: about 31–33 molecules of 10–18 atoms at two bases, 4 threads beside a CC wave; the 20 Oct laptop rows of 16–20-atom anchors took 1–4 h per molecule
